caption: The video captures a close-up, eye-level view of a clear handled glass mug positioned at the center of the frame, into which a pale yellow-green stream of juice falls continuously from above. The flow is already running and continues unbroken. Within the mug, the liquid surface climbs steadily toward the rim, gathering a thickening cap of pale froth as the stream strikes near the center. The descending column itself undulates, carrying traveling bulges and occasional droplet-like beads that move down its length. To the left sits a second glass already filled with the same juice, while a small metal cup rests at the right edge. Behind the mugs, a stainless-steel juicing machine and a stack of sugarcane stalks, one capped with bright green, remain softly blurred and fixed in place. As the pour continues, a tilted metal spout at the top-right corner grows gradually more visible beside the stream. The camera holds essentially static throughout, keeping the rising fill and the unbroken pour as the central focus.
relations: Continuous juice stream falling into the mug causes the liquid surface to climb steadily toward the rim.
The stream striking the center gathers a thickening cap of pale froth on the liquid surface.
The descending juice column undulates, carrying traveling bulges and droplet-like beads down its length.
Background elements remain fixed while a tilted metal spout at the top right grows more visible.
